name: Asakusa New Year Kabuki
desc: Young-star Kabuki in two parts: 11:00 and 15:00 at Asakusa Public Hall. Shorter and easier than the New National Theatre programme. Ages 4+ need a seat. Pair with Senso-ji. Price: ¥3,500–¥10,000; sale from 21 Nov 2026.

name: Shiki Back to the Future
desc: Japanese musical of the film, DeLorean on stage. About 2.5 hours. Ages 3+ need a ticket; under 3 not admitted. Afternoon slots exist most days. Japanese dialogue. Price: about ¥5,000–¥14,500 by seat and day.

name: Shiki Frozen
desc: Disney Frozen in Japanese, last Tokyo weeks before 17 Jan 2027 close. Child fares on some seats. About 2.5 hours with interval. Under 3 not admitted. Book early; finales sell out. Price: about ¥6,000–¥13,500; child seats cheaper.

name: Béjart Nutcracker
desc: Tokyo Ballet in Béjart’s Nutcracker, not the classic story-ballet. Four shows: 10 Jan 13:00 and 18:00; 11 Jan 12:00 and 16:00. Recorded score. Fine for a 10-year-old who can sit still. Price: see the official performance page.

name: Finding Neverland
desc: Musical about how Peter Pan was written. Tokyo run 8–30 Jan, then tour. About 3 hours with interval. U-20 / U-25 tickets exist. Japanese. Better for a child who likes stories than spectacle. Price: about ¥10,000–¥18,000; youth exchange tickets cheaper.

name: Robot in the Garden
desc: Shiki original: a man and a broken garden robot. Puppet-heavy, quieter than Frozen. Runs to 13 Feb 2027. Ages 3+ ticketed. Same Takeshiba cluster as the other Shiki houses. Price: about ¥5,000–¥13,500.
